messages.content: Choose chapter boundaries only. Do not rewrite story content. Return valid JSON only.

Each numbered statement is authoritative source material in story order.

1. A geologist completes a week of sampling in the desert.
2. Two months later, she begins laboratory analysis in another city.
3. The analysis continues through several repeated tests and occupies most of this section of the story.
4. After the testing is complete, she presents the final result to the research team.
5. One year later, she returns to the desert site to see how conditions have changed.

A chapter is a LARGE H3 refresh unit. Use as few boundaries as the narrative permits. Major time/location/state resets and entry into explicit terminal resolution can justify a boundary.

Return a JSON object with key "new_chapter_after". Its value is an array of statement numbers after which a new chapter should begin. Do not include the final statement number.
